paper.title: Wind Farm Layout Optimization (WindFLO): An Advanced Framework for Fast Wind Farm Analysis and Optimization

public_asset_candidate_evidence.status: identity revision license and semantics audited; evaluator data and validation inputs admitted as source authority
public_asset_candidate_evidence.source_oracle_status: public Example2 scalar metrics reproduced exactly after temporary compiler-port build

paper_source_conflicts: The target paper specifies local RBF terrain interpolation while public Example4 selects IDW.
The public disk sampler uses radius R times u, which oversamples the rotor center relative to uniform disk area.
The public DWM source repeatedly applies overlap to accumulated deficit instead of selecting the maximum weighted deficit.
The paper prints 26280 MWh for 25 V90-3MW turbines although the dimensionally correct annual rated farm energy is 657000 MWh and Table 4 follows the farm-scale denominator.
The public terrain arc approximation changes only rotated x although terrain height varies in both horizontal coordinates.
The public Larsen expression can produce negative deficits and the paper validation table reports unstable Larsen combinations.
missing_information: target SOHO source, random states, traces and four optimized layouts
numeric 2019 cli-MATE direction-speed table and raw observations
target population, generations, stagnation window, repeat count and exact rotor samples
completion_decisions: Use paper-local-RBF and corrected equal-area rotor sampling for optimization; use the source Sobol uniform-radius rule for Tables 2-3 validation and retain source-IDW as a named terrain conflict profile.
Use the intended DWM maximum weighted deficit and the physically correct 657000 MWh farm denominator.
Use true interpolated terrain elevation differences for three-dimensional wake separation.
Retain all six public wake models and four merge models for Tables 2 and 3; use only paper-selected Frandsen and BP for optimization.
Digitize Figure 10(c) into a versioned 16-direction by seven-speed wind quadrature without fitting Table 4.
Use SOHO population 100, 200 generations and stagnation 20; take kernel parameters from the author's dissertation and declare every relay completion.
Use one persistent all-core executor for complete offspring and validation roles with one/all-core scientific identity.
Run all 54 native roles and 25 platform seeds after immutable Waffle H6 admission.
prior_parallel_boundary: The target explicitly reports master-slave parallel optimization and the public PSO accepts an external parallel-evaluation callback. No target SOHO source, concrete schedule, deterministic one/all-core evidence, physical-work receipt or scaling result is public. The implementation claim is audited realization and measurement, not first parallelization.
